1.1 Insured's Declared Value (IDV)
The IDV of the vehicle is fixed on the basis of the manufacturer's listed selling price of the brand and model, adjusted for depreciation as per the following schedule: not exceeding 6 months - 5%; exceeding 6 months but not exceeding 1 year - 15%; exceeding 1 year but not exceeding 2 years - 20%; exceeding 2 years but not exceeding 3 years - 30%; exceeding 3 years but not exceeding 4 years - 40%; exceeding 4 years but not exceeding 5 years - 50%. The IDV of vehicles beyond 5 years of age and of obsolete models is determined by mutual agreement between the Company and the insured.

section_title: Loss or Damage to the Vehicle Insured
content:
2.1 Loss or Damage to the Vehicle Insured
The Company will indemnify the insured against loss or damage to the vehicle and its accessories caused by: fire, explosion, self-ignition or lightning; burglary, housebreaking or theft; riot and strike; earthquake (fire and shock damage); flood, typhoon, hurricane, storm, tempest, inundation, cyclone, hailstorm, frost; accidental external means; malicious act; terrorist activity; whilst in transit by road, rail, inland waterway, lift, elevator or air; landslide or rockslide. Depreciation on parts replaced is deducted as per Section 2.2.

2.2 Depreciation on Parts Replaced
In the case of partial loss, depreciation is deducted from the cost of parts replaced: rubber, nylon and plastic parts, tyres and tubes, batteries and airbags - 50%; fibreglass components - 30%; all parts made of glass - nil. For metal parts, depreciation depends on the age of the vehicle: not exceeding 6 months - nil; 6 months to 1 year - 5%; 1 to 2 years - 10%; 2 to 3 years - 15%; 3 to 4 years - 25%; 4 to 5 years - 35%; 5 to 10 years - 40%; exceeding 10 years - 50%.

3.1 Liability to Third Parties
The Company will indemnify the insured against legal liability arising out of the use of the vehicle for death of or bodily injury to any person, to the extent required by the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, without limit. Liability for damage to third-party property is covered up to Rs 7,50,000 per accident for a private car.

4.1 General Exclusions
The Company shall not be liable for: any accidental loss or damage occurring outside the geographical area; any claim arising out of contractual liability; loss or damage while the vehicle is driven by a person without a valid driving licence; loss or damage while the driver is under the influence of alcohol or drugs; consequential loss, depreciation, wear and tear, mechanical or electrical breakdown, failures or breakages; loss or damage caused by war, invasion, nuclear weapons or radioactive contamination.

5.1 No Claim Bonus
The insured is entitled to a No Claim Bonus (NCB) on the own damage premium if no claim is made during the preceding policy year(s): 20% after one claim-free year, 25% after two, 35% after three, 45% after four and 50% after five consecutive claim-free years. NCB is forfeited if a claim is made. NCB is retained if the policy is renewed within 90 days of expiry and may be transferred to a new vehicle of the same class on sale of the insured vehicle.

6.1 Claims Procedure
The insured must notify the Company within 48 hours of any accident or loss through the toll-free helpline, mobile app or website. In case of theft, an FIR must be lodged and the Company informed within 24 hours. Cashless repair is available at network garages; for non-network garages the insured pays and is reimbursed. Documents required: claim form, copy of RC, driving licence, policy copy, FIR (where applicable) and repair estimate.

7.1 Zero Depreciation Cover
In consideration of additional premium, depreciation on parts replaced under an admissible own damage claim will not be deducted. This add-on is available for vehicles up to 5 years old and is limited to 2 claims per policy year. Tyres and tubes are covered only when damaged in the same accident as other parts. The compulsory deductible under the policy continues to apply.

7.2 Engine and Gearbox Protection
The Company will pay for repair or replacement of engine and gearbox parts damaged due to water ingression, leakage of lubricating oil or hydrostatic lock, which are otherwise excluded as consequential loss. Available for vehicles up to 5 years old. Not covered: manufacturing defects, damage covered under the manufacturer's warranty, and damage from continued operation of the vehicle after the incident.

7.3 Emergency Roadside Assistance
24x7 assistance is provided for breakdown or accident: towing to the nearest authorised workshop up to 50 km, flat tyre change, battery jump-start, fuel delivery up to 5 litres (fuel cost borne by the insured), key lockout assistance and minor on-site repairs. A maximum of 4 assistance services are available per policy year.

7.4 Cost of Consumables
The Company will reimburse the cost of consumables used during repair of the vehicle under an admissible own damage claim, including engine oil, coolant, brake oil, AC gas, nuts, bolts, screws, washers, grease and bearings. Fuel is not covered. Payable only if the underlying own damage claim is admissible.

7.5 Return to Invoice
In the event of total loss, constructive total loss or theft of the vehicle, the Company will pay the difference between the IDV and the invoice value of the vehicle, together with first-time registration charges and road tax. Available for vehicles up to 3 years old.

7.6 Key Replacement
The Company will pay the cost of replacing lost or stolen vehicle keys, including the lock set if required, up to Rs 25,000 per policy year. A maximum of 2 claims are allowed per policy year. Theft of keys must be supported by a police report.
